subject: Atlanta Fed GDPNow (GDP nowcast, US)

gates.evidence: Bridge-equation nowcast; beats the no-change null on MAE by 75% (1.26 vs 5.05 pp)
gates.producer: Data: data/economics/gdpnow_vintages.json (ALFRED vintages); Script: python3 scripts/economics_gdpnow.py; Module: src/pacland/economics/gdpnow.py
gates.falsifier: the bridge equations would not aggregate to a GDP path at all, and the MAE ratio would sit at or above 1

gates.evidence: 28 of 37 quarters, MAE ratio 0.25 (<1 = beats the null)
gates.producer: Data: data/economics/gdpnow_vintages.json (ALFRED vintages); Script: python3 scripts/economics_gdpnow.py; Module: src/pacland/economics/gdpnow.py
gates.falsifier: ratio >= 1.0, i.e. no better than carrying the previous quarter forward

gates.evidence: Against the settled number it still beats the null: MAE ratio 0.31 on all 37 quarters, 0.75 excluding 2020 — the edge narrows but survives
gates.producer: Data: data/economics/gdpnow_vintages.json (ALFRED vintages); Script: python3 scripts/economics_gdpnow.py; Module: src/pacland/economics/gdpnow.py
gates.falsifier: a settled-number ratio above 1.0, or one that flips when 2020 is dropped

gates.evidence: Real-time vintages (ALFRED) throughout; a vintage that post-dates the forecast is refused by guard_nowcast_predates_release
gates.producer: Data: data/economics/gdpnow_vintages.json (ALFRED vintages); Script: python3 scripts/economics_gdpnow.py; Module: src/pacland/economics/gdpnow.py
gates.falsifier: a fixture where the nowcast vintage post-dates the release — the guard would go red and the evaluation would be refused

gates.evidence: Four guards, each mutation-proved: vintage ordering, shared benchmark vintage, first-publication target, units
gates.producer: Data: data/economics/gdpnow_vintages.json (ALFRED vintages); Script: python3 scripts/economics_gdpnow.py; Module: src/pacland/economics/gdpnow.py
gates.falsifier: each guard is mutation-proved: the seeded fault makes it read red

limitations: The advantage survives the settled-number target but narrows sharply: 0.25 against the advance estimate, 0.75 against the settled number excluding 2020.
The evaluation uses one public dataset and one target definition; neither has been independently replicated outside this repository.
